exactly_once_committed_effects.activation_guard: NODE_ENV=test AND VISIONSCAN_TEST_ISOLATED=1 AND explicit VISIONSCAN_PHASE9_FAULT_INJECTION; no route or production activation path

graceful_shutdown.windows_ctrl_c_path: SIGINT handler is explicit in scripts/worker.ts; live Windows console experiment remains NOT_MEASURED
graceful_shutdown.durable_recovery: current lease remains recoverable through existing stale/retry fencing

deadline_and_cleanup.provider_cleanup: tracked child-tree termination is wired to cancellation/deadline; descendant absence is NOT independently measured
deadline_and_cleanup.phase8_real_provider_observation: 120000ms queue-claim deadline; 15 completed and 10 deadline failures at the 25-job point

load_characterization.policy: bounded queue timeout, service deadline, total-age budget, explicit bounded rejection

review_governance.finalized_report: immutable; another review cannot mutate a clinician_finalized projection
review_governance.concurrent_projection: revision mismatch preserves the incoming event, retains the stored projection, and sets CONCURRENT_REVIEW_CONFLICT
review_governance.final_assessment: required for finalize and stored separately from AI output

release_boundary: No model, dataset, resident runtime, clinical validation, diagnostic sensitivity, disease recovery, or medical-device claim is promoted by this artifact.
